title: Introducing Triton: Open-source GPU programming for neural networks
summary: We’re releasing Triton 1.0, an open-source Python-like programming language which enables researchers with no CUDA experience to write highly efficient GPU code—most of the time on par with what an expert would be able to produce.
body: We’re releasing Triton 1.0, an open-source Python-like programming language which enables researchers with no CUDA experience to write highly efficient GPU code—most of the time on par with what an expert would be able to produce.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了Triton 1.0，这是一个开源的、类Python的GPU编程语言。它允许没有CUDA经验的研究人员编写出与专家编写的效率相当的高性能GPU代码，从而降低了深度学习底层算子开发的门槛。
